title: The audacity of bupropion
line: what it takes to enter a market everyone else has defined, for anyone weighing a differentiated mechanism against a crowded one: 25 approved drugs were chasing serotonin, bupropion chased neither
question: Bupropion went into a depression market that serotonin had defined, with a drug that does not touch serotonin. What was the commercial case for that, and what did the molecule end up being worth?
data: ChEMBL approved-drug mechanisms for the three monoamine transporters
all 508 registered trials with bupropion as an intervention, 1994 to 2025
did: counted every approved drug in ChEMBL acting on the serotonin, dopamine and norepinephrine transporters, to size the market bupropion chose not to enter.
pulled all 508 registered bupropion trials and bucketed them by condition text into indication families, then tracked each family cumulatively by start year.
read the mechanism records against the trial record to see whether the commercial life of the molecule followed its original indication or its pharmacology.
found: 25 approved drugs inhibit the serotonin transporter. Bupropion inhibits dopamine and norepinephrine transporters and does not touch serotonin, which put it outside the mechanism every competitor was built on.

bupropion's mechanistic neighbours are not antidepressants. the ten approved drugs that hit dopamine and norepinephrine without serotonin are bupropion, methylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate, serdexmethylphenidate, amphetamine, dextroamphetamine, lisdexamfetamine, diethylpropion, phendimetrazine and phenmetrazine: the ADHD stimulant class and the anorectics.

the mechanistic class is a chemical class too. the ten are more structurally similar to each other than chance allows (mean Tanimoto 0.25 against 0.14 for the rest, permutation p below 0.001), and they are smaller and less lipophilic than the other 47. polarity does not distinguish them.
ten approved drugs hit both dopamine and norepinephrine transporters without serotonin. Bupropion is the one that was marketed for depression.
smoking and nicotine trials passed depression trials in 1999 and never gave the lead back. Across the dated record there are 164 smoking trials against 138 for depression.
obesity and weight trials start in 2005 and reach 56, a third indication family the original filing did not anticipate.
the differentiated mechanism is what made the second and third lives possible. A serotonergic molecule would not have had a smoking-cessation story to tell.
so_what: a mechanism nobody else is using is a weaker launch position and a stronger franchise. Bupropion gave up the ability to be compared favourably with the market leader, and bought the ability to be used where the market leader could not go.

the mechanism predicted the indications before the market found them. a molecule sitting with stimulants and appetite suppressants was always going to end up in smoking cessation and obesity, whatever the launch label said. that is a repurposing signal available from a target table on day one, years before the trials.
the value of an atypical mechanism shows up in indication count, not in the first label. Anyone valuing a differentiated asset on its launch indication alone is pricing the wrong thing.

this is the counterpart to the Wegovy teardown. There a brand defended a crowded class by buying a claim its rival could not make; here a brand entered a crowded class by refusing the mechanism that defined it.
calls: approved drugs per target rather than prescription volume. Prescription data is proprietary; the mechanism landscape is public and is what a development decision actually faces.

trial counts as the proxy for commercial attention, since they are the public record of where sponsors spent. They undercount marketing and overcount academic interest, and that is stated rather than corrected for.
condition text buckets rather than MeSH terms. The registry's free-text conditions are messy but they are what sponsors actually wrote.
Morgan fingerprints with a permutation test rather than a picture of a cluster. ten points can look grouped in any projection, so the claim rests on the similarity statistic, not on the layout.
not_shown: revenue, prescription share and the internal case for the original programme are not public, so the commercial story here is reconstructed from the mechanism and trial record only
the 1986 withdrawal over seizure risk and the 1989 reintroduction are part of this story and are not yet in the figures

figures.note: every approved drug on the three monoamine transporters, grouped by which it hits. the highlighted row is the ten that take dopamine and norepinephrine while leaving serotonin alone: bupropion, and otherwise the ADHD stimulant class and the appetite suppressants. the drug filed as an antidepressant has no antidepressant neighbours.

the same ten drugs in chemical space. left, Morgan fingerprints projected to two components: they are more similar to each other than any random ten of the 57, mean Tanimoto 0.25 against 0.14, permutation p below 0.001. right, they are smaller (median MW 219 against 275) and less lipophilic (cLogP 1.9 against 3.3). polarity does not separate them, p = 0.60.
